romance.t: Write a love letter and leave it where they will find it today.
Recreate your first date as closely as you can.
Slow dance in the living room to your song.
Give a coupon for a night where they choose everything.
Plan a picnic under the stars.
Make a playlist of 10 songs that remind you of them and play it together.
Say 'I love you' in five different ways in one evening.
Look through old photos and tell the story behind your favourite.

playful.t: Have a pillow fight and the loser gives a foot rub.
Play a round of any board game, winner picks a kiss spot.
Build a blanket fort and spend an hour in it.
Have a tickle war. First to surrender gives a massage.
Do a silly dance-off. Loser does what the winner says for ten minutes.
Take ten photos of the two of you in silly poses.
Make up a secret handshake and a secret word.
Play truth or dare for fifteen minutes.

talk.t: Share three things you have never told them.
Tell each other your favourite memory of the two of you.
Describe your ideal weekend together in detail.
Tell each other one thing you want more of in bed.
Share a secret fantasy. No judgement, only curiosity.
Write each other a three-sentence love note and read it aloud.
Ask three questions you have never asked.
Say what you appreciate about each other, one by one, for five minutes.

kisses.t: Kiss for ten minutes with no hands.
Kiss in every room of your home.
Play the Kiss Roulette: roll dice for where and how.
Kiss slowly from the neck to the shoulder to the wrist.
Kiss for the length of one whole song.
Give each other a different kind of kiss until you run out of ideas.
Almost-kiss five times, then finally kiss.
Kiss in the rain, or under the shower.

touch.t: Give a slow massage for twenty minutes with no goal.
Trace letters on each other's backs and guess the words.
Give each other a foot massage with warm oil.
Spend ten minutes just stroking each other's arms and hands.
Cuddle skin to skin for fifteen minutes.
Massage each other's scalp until they melt.
Draw a body map of where you love being touched and compare.
Try a full-body massage with a surprise oil.

senses.t: Blindfold your partner and give them three surprise touches.
Taste test: feed each other five blindfolded bites.
Create a scent trail with candles and flowers.
Play only one slow song and move together.
Whisper into their ear for two minutes.
Trace ice along their skin and warm it with your breath.
Hot and cold: alternate a warm cloth and a cool cloth.
Pick a texture (silk, fur, feather) and use it for ten minutes.

outside.t: Go for a walk and share a long kiss somewhere beautiful.
Kiss at the top of a hill, tower or rooftop.
Have a late-night drive with no destination.
Sit in a cafe, whisper something naughty and say nothing else.
Take a nighttime beach walk and kiss in the waves.
Book a one-night stay in your own city.
Go to a quiet spot and dance to one song.

kitchen.t: Cook a three-course dinner and feed each other.
Make dessert together and wear it.
Make cocktails or mocktails and invent a toast.
Share a meal with no cutlery.
Pick a recipe your partner loves and surprise them.
Eat breakfast in bed and stay there all morning.

water.t: Take a long candlelit bath together.
Shower together and wash each other slowly.
Warm the towels and dry each other.
Play a game in the bath: truth or dare with bubbles.
Float candles and read a love poem.
Share a hot drink in the tub and talk about your day.

role.t: Meet as strangers at a bar and pick each other up.
Dress as your partner's fantasy character for one hour.
Pretend it is your first night together.
Act out a scene from a film.
Be a hotel guest and a concierge with a secret.
Play boss and employee after work.
Play doctor and patient for a gentle check-up.
Pick a role each from the Roleplay Studio and play for an hour.

tease.t: Tease with no touching for five minutes, then touch for one.
Edge-free teasing: stop each time they get close.
Send teasing messages all day, then follow through at night.
Whisper what you will do later and make them wait.
Take ten minutes to undress them with only your fingertips.
Tease them through their clothes for ten minutes.
Make them count down from twenty while you tease.
Give three 'not yet's before you say yes.

power.t: Be in charge for twenty minutes. They follow every instruction.
Blindfold and gently restrain with a soft scarf.
Give them a command and enjoy the pleasure of being obeyed.
Use a safe word and a clear start and stop time.
They ask permission for each kiss.
Take it in turns being the leader for ten minutes each.
Try a light spank with a clear yes.
Write a simple contract of what is on and off the menu.

wild.t: A whole night of nothing but yes (within agreed limits).
Try something from your Desire Match list.
Pick a position from the selector and try it.
Try a new place in the house.
Surprise them with something daring you planned all week.
Have a long, slow night with no clock.
Finish with a long cuddle and a debrief of what you loved.

season.t: Valentine: write three reasons you chose each other and swap them.
Summer: share an ice cream and feed each other the first three bites.
Summer: swim or paddle together and float holding hands for five minutes.
Autumn: take a walk through leaves, then share a hot drink and a long cuddle.
Winter: build a blanket nest, put on a film and keep each other warm.
Winter: slow-dance to one song in the living room, lights low.
Spring: pick flowers together and give each other a bouquet with a note.
New Year: write one wish each for the year and one wish for you as a couple.
Birthday week: plan a mini-surprise for your partner and tell them to expect something.
Anniversary: re-read your first messages to each other aloud.
Rainy day: dance in the rain or in the kitchen, whichever is drier.
Holiday: make a card for each other, no store-bought.
Sunrise: wake early and watch the sun come up together.
Full moon: step outside and share one secret you have never told.
Long weekend: pick a "yes day" where each of you gets two requests.
Midnight: share a midnight snack and talk about your first date.
